model_system: URu2Si2 hidden-order phase modeled as a spin-orbit density wave between nested spin-orbit-split 5f bands
headline_claim: SODW reproduces the hidden-order gap phenomenology and predicts a zero-temperature quantum critical field close to the experimental Bc ~ 35 T.
replication_difficulty: high - requires DFT-derived low-energy bands for URu2Si2 plus self-consistent SODW mean-field and RPA spin-excitation calculations.
